projectState.summary: Byte 12b-c is implemented on `codex/byte-12b-c` and awaiting review. It adds a manual Ollama proposal-text probe that may rewrite only the readable `SongSketchProposal` text slots: summary, requested action, and per-player response reasons/requested changes. Proposal kind, target section, proposer, chord/root provenance, player ids, response stances, routing, playback, transport, slow-thinking, persistence, and scheduling stay deterministic. Invalid or failed model text keeps the mock proposal active with a valid fallback. `npm audit`, `npm run build`, `npm run smoke`, `git diff --check`, and in-app browser UI sanity are green.
